SECTION 43 OF INTERNATIONAL BANKING AND TRUST
COMPANIES ACT (CAP. 11.04).
1. Citation
This Order may be cited as the International Banking and Trust
Companies (Fees) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations, 2025.
2. Schedule amended
The Schedule of International Banking and Trust Companies
(Fees) Regulations, (Cap. 11.04) is deleted and substituted with the
following—

international banking business or banking and trust
business………………………………………………
